decisions.statement: A charge matching several orders is abstained on and never written.
A charge matching no order is reported and left alone.
The before-picture of every Amazon row is taken before anything is written.
A single row may be named.
A named row outside the matched ones has its live note reported rather than a match invented.
A message with no order number is counted rather than passed over silently.
The rows written and the rows declined and the order numbers owed are all tallied at the end.

definition: the Amazon order confirmations matched to charges and written on as notes
